pointwise_checks: Unchanged BF16 rtol0.01/atol0.02 and FP32 rtol1.3e-6/atol1e-5, followed by an additional global check.
global_check: FP64 Frobenius norm(actual-reference) <= dtype_relative_budget * Frobenius norm(reference), with no absolute floor. Exact-zero reference requires exact-zero output.
BF16_basis: BF16 has7 fraction bits, unit roundoffu=2^-8. Two rounded copies of the same FP32 value differ by at most2u/(1-u) relative to the rounded reference. This output-precision scale defines the independent global accuracy requirement; actual stock FP32 reduction error was measured against it.
FP32_basis: The existing PyTorch float32 relative accuracy component, without its absolute floor for the additional global check.
native_calibration: Unchanged; the added requirement applies only to candidate/port outputs.
full_framework_and_trusted_qualification: Pending fresh runs of this strengthened contract; earlier pointwise-only PASS remains scoped to its old contract.
